name: Horn-Bad Meinberg (Germany)
description: Horizontally divided blue over white, charged at the centre with the city arms of Horn-Bad Meinberg (a hunting horn above a temple on blue).
history: Municipal flag of Horn-Bad Meinberg; German municipalities use their flags alongside the arms, the hoisted form (Hissflagge) and the hanging banner (Banner) sharing the same design.

features.role: Horn-Bad Meinberg arms — hunting horn and temple on blue
